verdict.rationale: Granola has a dedicated model-training privacy page saying users can opt out of model training in Settings at any time, which directly delivers the story. Community posts only voice general worry about data use and do not show the opt-out failing, so they do not create a dispute. Missing for 10: details on the default setting and the opt-out's scope (whether it covers third-party AI providers or workspace-wide admin enforcement), and independent or hands-on confirmation that it works.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can prevent my data from being used to train AI models
